title: 第46章 毒瘴规则之力第45章 雾渊泽
lines: 白枫懒得再与岸边的火山多费口舌，唇角噙着一抹淡笑，不再回头，径直纵身，彻底钻入雾渊泽深处。
可刚脱离沼泽边缘，一头扎进浓稠无边的苍绿色薄雾之中，刺骨的异变骤然爆发。
没有肉身皮肉的刺痛，而是一股源自神魂本源的灼烧感猛地席卷全身，像是有无数根烧红的细针，密密麻麻扎入识海每一处角落，神魂阵阵发麻发颤，头痛欲裂。
白枫脸色骤然一白，心底暗惊：
不好，这雾气有莫名的毒素！
而且剧毒蚀魂！
他不敢耽搁，心神一动，识海内闵天幡瞬间凌空浮现，万丈温润净化金光倾泻而出，纯净功德圣光笼罩周身，试图强行涤荡周遭侵体的绿雾毒瘴。
往日里，无论是域外诅咒、阴邪煞气、还是各类邪毒浊气，闵天幡的功德圣光都能一扫而空，从无败绩。
可此刻金光笼罩之下，周遭绿雾仅仅短暂退散片刻，便再度蜂拥而上，死死包裹白枫周身，蚀魂灼烧的痛感不仅没有减弱，反倒变本加厉，愈发狂暴。
白枫心头一沉，眼底第一次生出凝重。
闵天幡中蕴含着最为纯净的功德之力，这些功德之力能净化一些邪瘴！
可是现在连至纯至净的功德之力都无法彻底净化此毒，这雾渊泽的瘴气，早已超脱世间寻常毒素范畴。
这一刻他彻底明白火山忌惮的缘由。
火鸦一族掌控天火烈焰，火克万毒，境界高升如火山达到圣灵境界尚且不敢踏入此地，更何况是依靠灵宝净化毒素的自己。
意识到不妙，白枫当即转身，想要原路退回沼泽岸边，重回对峙之地。
可猛然回头，他浑身瞬间冰凉。
来时清晰可见的沼泽岸边、火山端坐的身影，已然彻底消失。
四面八方全是浓稠不散的绿雾，遮天蔽日，隔绝光线与神识，上下左右全是一模一样的晦暗沼泽黑水，根本分不清来路与方向。
整片空间彻底被毒雾封锁。
白枫强行催动灵力，想要撕裂雾气后退，可一旦灵气运转，周遭绿雾如同附骨之疽，顺着灵气流转的经脉，疯狂钻入体内，腐蚀经脉，侵扰神魂，毒力侵入速度陡然暴涨数倍。
霸道至极的毒瘴，竟能借力修士自身灵气，反向侵体！
白枫压下体内翻涌的浊气，凝神稳步后退，足足全速飞行十多分钟，可眼前风景毫无变化，依旧是无边无际的腐败沼泽，黑水冒泡，绿雾弥漫，来路彻底断绝。
他彻底迷失在了雾渊泽之中。
此刻他才真正读懂这片绝地名字的含义：
入雾不见归途，一步坠入深渊，故名雾渊。
还未等白枫稳住心神，周遭沼泽黑水之中，开始断断续续亮起一簇簇幽绿色光点，星星点点，慢慢从水底浮起。
是沼泽蜥。
通体覆满滑腻黑甲，双目泛着幽绿毒光，体型细长，周身散发着浓郁腐臭气息，成群结队围拢而来。
这类阴暗异兽修为低微，充其量只有人族金丹境水准，对白枫而言，随手便可碾杀，不值一提。
可下一瞬，白枫瞳孔骤缩，立刻止住出手的念头。
只见一头靠近的沼泽蜥被气流惊扰，猛然爆裂开来，尸身碎裂的瞬间，一团浓度远超周遭雾气的剧毒绿雾轰然炸开，四散飘入空气，让周边毒瘴毒性瞬间暴涨一截。
content_en:
Bai Feng was too lazy to talk to the volcano on the shore. With a faint smile on his lips, he jumped straight into the depths of the mist without looking back.
But as soon as he left the edge of the swamp and plunged into the thick and boundless pale green mist, a bone-chilling change suddenly broke out.
There was no tingling pain in the flesh, but a burning sensation originating from the soul's origin suddenly swept through the whole body, like countless red-hot thin needles, densely piercing into every corner of the sea of ​​consciousness. The soul was numb and trembling, and a splitting headache occurred.
Bai Feng's face suddenly turned pale, and he was secretly shocked:
No, this mist has inexplicable toxins!
And the poison is so poisonous that it erodes the soul!
He did not dare to delay, and with a thought, the Min Tianbanner instantly appeared in the sky in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and the warm and purifying golden light poured out. The pure holy light of merit enveloped the whole body, trying to forcibly cleanse the green mist and poisonous miasma that invaded the surrounding body.
In the past, whether it was foreign curses, evil spirits, or all kinds of evil poisons and turbid odors, the holy light of Min Tianban's merits could be swept away without fail.
But at this moment, under the golden light, the surrounding green mist only retreated for a moment, and then swarmed up again, tightly wrapping Bai Feng's body. The soul-eating and burning pain not only did not weaken, but intensified and became more violent.
Bai Feng's heart sank, and his eyes became solemn for the first time.
The Min Tian Banner contains the purest power of merit, which can purify some evil miasma!
But now even the most pure power of merit cannot completely purify this poison. The miasma in Wuyuanze has long transcended the scope of ordinary poisons in the world.
At this moment, he completely understood the reason for Huoshan's fear.
The Fire Crow Clan controls the blazing flames of heaven, and fire can defeat all poisons. Their realm has risen as high as a volcano and they have reached the realm of the Holy Spirit. They dare not step into this place, let alone themselves who rely on spiritual treasures to purify toxins.
Realizing that something was wrong, Bai Feng immediately turned around and wanted to return to the swamp shore and return to the confrontation.
But when he suddenly turned around, his whole body became ice-cold.
The figures sitting on the swamp shore and the volcano that were clearly visible when they arrived have completely disappeared.
There was thick and persistent green mist in all directions, blocking out the sky and the sun, cutting off light and spiritual consciousness. Above, below, left, and right, there was the same dark swamp and black water, and it was impossible to tell the way and direction.
The entire space was completely blocked by poisonous fog.
Bai Feng forced his spiritual power to tear apart the mist and retreat, but once the spiritual energy circulated, the surrounding green mist was like gangrene attached to the bones. Following the meridians flowing through the spiritual energy, it crazily penetrated into the body, corroding the meridians and intruding the soul. The speed of the poisonous invasion suddenly increased several times.
The extremely overbearing poisonous miasma can actually use the monk's own spiritual energy to invade the body in reverse!
Bai Feng suppressed the turbid air surging in his body, and retreated steadily with concentration, flying at full speed for more than ten minutes. However, the scenery in front of him did not change. It was still an endless corrupt swamp, with bubbling black water, filled with green mist, and the way in was completely cut off.
He was completely lost in the mist.
Only at this moment did he truly understand the meaning of this Jedi's name:
When you enter the fog, you can't see the way back, and you fall into the abyss in one step, hence the name Mist Abyss.
Before Bai Feng could calm down, clusters of green light spots began to light up intermittently in the black water of the surrounding swamp, and stars slowly emerged from the bottom of the water.
It's a swamp lizard.
The whole body is covered with smooth black armor, the eyes are glowing with green poisonous light, the body is slender, and the whole body exudes a strong putrid smell, and they gather in groups.
The cultivation level of this kind of dark alien beast is low, at best it is only at the level of human golden elixir realm. To Bai Feng, they can be easily crushed and killed, so they are not worth mentioning.
But in the next moment, Bai Feng's pupils shrank suddenly and he immediately stopped thinking about taking action.
An approaching swamp lizard was disturbed by the airflow and suddenly exploded. The moment the body shattered into pieces, a cloud of highly toxic green mist that far exceeded the surrounding fog exploded and scattered into the air, causing the surrounding poisonous miasma to instantly increase in toxicity.
title_en: Chapter 46 The power of poisonous miasma rules Chapter 45 Wuyuanze
